scope: Actual pinned timeout snapshots/checks, missed yield, ordered event/delayed/suspended placement, mutex disinherit and list insert/remove; full TCB canaries and shared state/list memory
limitations: Critical entry/exit are bounded fixtures. The104-byte accessed TCB prefix preserves the native stack-depth word; full112-byte construction/tail fields remain gated. No scheduler startup/context switching, physical concurrency or whole-image identity proof.
